adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a new `Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and changes `Post#cook` to `return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, which bypasses the normal cooking/filtering pipeline (`post_analyzer.cook` + plugin filters). The new feed/import paths set this mode: `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts via `PostCreator.new(... raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents), skip_validations: true, cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html])`, where `contents` comes from RSS (`CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`) or fetched HTML (`Readability::Document`), neither of which is shown being sanitized against scripts/JS URLs/event handlers. The embed view then renders `raw post.cooked` (`app/views/embed/best.html.erb`), and since `cook` returns `raw`, the stored cooked HTML will be attacker-controlled verbatim. This is a verifiable stored-XSS risk introduced by the diff.
